name: What is the typical cost range for rental turnover renovations?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for rental turnover renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of rental turnover renovations varies widely based on the scope and property size. Minor updates, such as painting and touch-ups, might range from a few hundred to a couple of thousand dollars. More extensive renovations, including kitchen and bathroom updates or full flooring replacement, can range from $5,000 to over $20,000. It is best to get detailed quotes from contractors based on your specific project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for rental renovations vary; minor updates are hundreds to thousands, while extensive projects can exceed $20,000. Get detailed quotes.
